description: Schema vectors of libre-ai.brique.v1 (ADR-0064 D2). Each invalid vector is the first valid one with one change, named in `because`; briques.test.ts applies the change and expects the schema to refuse it.

valid.name: a method brick with a local proof

briques.role: Tient, pour chaque produit, la liste des menaces et la preuve qui ferme chacune.

origine.source: vision externe en briques inspectée le 2026-11-09

valid.name: a product brick with its charter, an observed origin and a pinned proof

briques.role: Suit des sources depuis le poste et garde hors ligne ce qui a été conservé.

charte.valeur: Suivre des sources depuis son poste sans qu'un serveur tiers sache ce qu'on lit.
charte.pour_qui: Une personne ou une organisation qui veille des sources.
charte.degel: Les trois surfaces construites sur le même cœur, sur une release signée.
charte.abandon: Le parseur isolé ne tient pas le seuil mémoire sur un corpus réel.
refus: Stocker une donnée de paiement dans l'application.

briques.jetable: until=la fiche du dépôt porteur reprend la charte

invalid.name: a typed status
invalid.because: ADR-0064 D4: the status is derived, never typed

invalid.name: an unknown field
invalid.because: the schema is closed: an unread field is a claim nothing checks

invalid.name: an identifier without a layer prefix
invalid.because: the prefix is how a dependency names its layer

invalid.name: an inspection without its source
invalid.because: I-33: an origin by inspection names what was inspected

invalid.name: an observation without its date
invalid.because: an observed origin is a dated fact

invalid.name: an autonomy outside the three levels
invalid.because: ADR-0064 D2 names discover, modify and govern

invalid.name: a proof without a date
invalid.because: a proof is dated, or it is a claim

invalid.name: a decision that is neither an ADR nor a register row
invalid.because: a decision is cited by its identifier, so that it resolves

invalid.name: a transitional brick without its condition
invalid.because: jetable names the condition that ends the brick

invalid.name: a layer file with no brick
invalid.because: an empty layer is a missing source, not zero bricks
